# Task P4-01: InnerTube search client

**Phase:** 4 · **Depends on:** P4-00 (fixtures, decisions) · **Suggested tier:** T2 standard worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal

The YouTube Music search half of the YouTube source: a small, keyless InnerTube client in `Wondarr.Sources.YouTube` that posts the WEB_REMIX `search` request (songs filter, then videos when the source rule allows it, ISRC query first when the song has ISRCs) and parses the response into the existing `Candidate` contract with ATV/OMV/UGC typing. After this task the search works against recorded fixtures; the provider wiring (search strategy, grab, status, cancel) is P4-04.

## Deliverables

- `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/InnertubeClient.cs` — the HTTP client: `SearchAsync(InnertubeSearchRequest, CancellationToken) -> InnertubeSearchResult`.
- `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/InnertubeModels.cs` — the request/response records: `InnertubeSearchRequest` (query, filter), the parsed result item (`InnertubeResult`: videoId, title, artists, album, durationMs, musicVideoType, isExplicit), and the filter enum (`Songs`, `Videos`, `None` for the ISRC query).
- `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/InnertubeResponseParser.cs` — the pure response→results parser (no HTTP): walks `contents.tabbedSearchResultsRenderer.tabs[0].tabRenderer.content.sectionListRenderer.contents[]`, reads `musicShelfRenderer` items and the `musicCardShelfRenderer` top result, and maps each onto `InnertubeResult`.
- `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/YouTubeOptions.cs` — the `youtube` section of `config.yml`: `enabled` (default false), `cookies_path` (default null), `po_token_base_url` (default null), `allow_videos` (default false), `search_limit` (default 20), plus its validator (every failure message starts with the YAML key).
- `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/YouTubeCandidateMapper.cs` — `InnertubeResult` → `Candidate` (the Core contract): `SourceType = SourceTypes.YouTube`, `BlocklistKey = "youtube:" + videoId`, `DisplayName = title`, `RemotePath = videoId`, `Provider = channel/artist`, `Parsed` (title/artists/album from the result), `DurationMs`, `Extension` (null — unknown until download), `QualityId` (OPUS-160 = 28 for ATV/OMV/UGC — YouTube serves Opus 251 at best), `Availability` (flat 120 availability is the engine's YouTube rule — set `FreeUploadSlot = true` so the engine's availability score is 80+30), and the raw result in `Query`.
- `src/Wondarr.Sources.YouTube/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` — register the client (typed `HttpClient` named `"innertube"`, `AddWondarrYouTube`).
- Tests under `tests/Wondarr.Sources.Tests/YouTube/`: `InnertubeClientTests` (contract tests against the recorded fixtures), `InnertubeResponseParserTests` (golden cases: songs shelf, videos shelf, ISRC card + item sections, empty response, error response), `YouTubeOptionsValidatorTests`, `YouTubeCandidateMapperTests`.

## Constraints

- **Keyless.** No API key, no `X-Goog-Api-Key` header, no scraped visitor id. The request is exactly: `POST {base}/youtubei/v1/search?alt=json` with the body `{"context":{"client":{"clientName":"WEB_REMIX","clientVersion":"<computed>","hl":"en"},"user":{}},"query":<query>,"params":<params?>}` where `clientVersion` is `"1." + DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd") + ".01.00"` (computed per request, never hardcoded) and `params` is omitted for the ISRC query. Headers: `content-type: application/json`, `origin: https://music.youtube.com`, `user-agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0`, `cookie: SOCS=CAI`, `accept: */*`. The base address is `https://music.youtube.com` (configurable for tests: `youtube.base_url` in `YouTubeOptions`, default the real one).
- **`params` constants** (verified 2026-10-05, `docs/research/research_youtube.md` §0.1): songs = `EgWKAQIIAWoMEA4QChADEAQQCRAF`, videos = `EgWKAQIQAWoMEA4QChADEAQQCRAF`. The ISRC query sends **no** `params` (an ISRC with the songs filter returns junk — the recorded `search-isrc.json` shows the unfiltered shape).
- **Response paths** (verified): shelf items at `contents.tabbedSearchResultsRenderer.tabs[0].tabRenderer.content.sectionListRenderer.contents[].musicShelfRenderer.contents[].musicResponsiveListItemRenderer`; the top result at `contents[0].musicCardShelfRenderer` (title `runs[0].text`, videoId/videoType under `title.runs[0].navigationEndpoint.watchEndpoint` or the `onTap` play button — read both paths defensively). Per item: videoId under `overlay.musicItemThumbnailOverlayRenderer.content.musicPlayButtonRenderer.playNavigationEndpoint.watchEndpoint.videoId` (also in `flexColumns[0].runs[0].navigationEndpoint.watchEndpoint.videoId` — either path); `musicVideoType` under the same `watchEndpoint` + `watchEndpointMusicSupportedConfigs.watchEndpointMusicConfig.musicVideoType`; title = `flexColumns[0]` `runs[0].text`; artists = `flexColumns[1]` runs with a `browseEndpoint` (skip the separators `", "`, `" & "`, `" • "`); album = the `flexColumns[1]` run with a browse id that is not an artist (or the run before the duration); duration = the last `flexColumns[1]` run matching `^(\d+:)*\d+:\d+$` (parse `H:MM:SS`/`MM:SS` to milliseconds; there is **no** `duration_seconds` in the raw response).
- **`musicVideoType` mapping**: `MUSIC_VIDEO_TYPE_ATV` → the result is an Art Track (verified, the best single-song candidate); `MUSIC_VIDEO_TYPE_OMV` → official music video; `MUSIC_VIDEO_TYPE_UGC` → user upload; anything else (e.g. `PRIVATELY_OWNED_TRACK`, `PODCAST_EPISODE`) → treat as UGC-equivalent (not grabbable by default). Keep the raw string on the parsed result.
- **No network in tests.** Contract tests serve the recorded fixtures through the stub handler; live tests are opt-in (`WONDARR_LIVE_TESTS=1`), never in CI, one search, `search_limit` respected.
- **Rate limits.** The client itself enforces nothing (the provider's pacing is P4-04); but it must send `Accept-Encoding` defaults and use `HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead` (responses are hundreds of KB).
- **Errors.** A non-2xx response throws `InnertubeException` carrying the status code and the first line of the error body (the recorded `search-error.json` shows the 400 shape); a 429/503 is the same exception (the provider decides retry-later). Never parse a failed body as results.
- **Attribution.** The parser's rules are derived from ytmusicapi (MIT, https://github.com/sigma67/ytmusicapi) and spotDL (MIT, https://github.com/spotDL/spotify-downloader) — add the `Ported from` header comment and a `NOTICE.md` row (the check is CI-enforced: `python scripts/check-notice.py`).

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)

1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` and `dotnet test` green (the whole solution, not just this project).
2. `InnertubeClientTests.Posts_the_keyless_WEB_REMIX_search_request`: serving `search-songs.json`, a `SearchAsync` call sends exactly one POST to `youtubei/v1/search?alt=json` with the WEB_REMIX context, the computed `clientVersion` (`1.<today>01.00`), the songs `params`, the Firefox UA, `origin: https://music.youtube.com`, the `SOCS=CAI` cookie, **no API key anywhere in the request** (assert: no `key` query parameter, no `X-Goog-Api-Key` header), and parses 6 results with the first being videoId `4D7u5KF7SP8`, title `Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers)`, artists `["Daft Punk", "Pharrell Williams", "Nile Rodgers"]`, album `Random Access Memories`, duration 370000 ms, type ATV.
3. `InnertubeResponseParserTests` golden cases over every fixture: the songs shelf (6 items, all ATV or UGC as recorded), the videos shelf (first item UGC at 248000 ms — the official-video hazard), the ISRC response (the card is `HzdD8kbDzZA` ATV 226000 ms "Take on Me" by a-ha; the item sections parse too), an empty response (`contents` missing or empty → zero results, no throw), and the 400 error body (throws `InnertubeException` with the status).
4. `YouTubeCandidateMapperTests`: an ATV result maps to a `Candidate` with `SourceType = "youtube"`, `BlocklistKey = "youtube:4D7u5KF7SP8"`, `QualityId = 28` (OPUS-160), `DurationMs` carried, `Parsed.Title` the base title, `Parsed.Artist` the first artist, `Parsed.Album` the album; a UGC result maps with the same shape (the engine, not the mapper, decides acceptability).
5. `YouTubeOptionsValidatorTests`: `youtube.enabled: false` default; `youtube.search_limit` bounds 1–50; `youtube.base_url` must be a valid absolute URI when set; failures name their YAML key.
6. `ServiceCollectionExtensionsTests`: `AddWondarrYouTube` registers `InnertubeClient` (as the interface), the named `HttpClient`, and the options validator; calling it twice is harmless.

## Out of scope

- The source provider (`ISourceProvider`), grab/status/cancel, yt-dlp (P4-02), the output policy (P4-03), the search strategy and early-stop (P4-04), the settings API/UI (P4-05).
- `get_song`/`get_album`/watch-playlist endpoints; lyrics; anything but `search`.
- Any scoring or accept/reject decision (the decision engine's job).
